zh.title: 法國規劃國家級下一代戰機，目標2040年投入常規任務
zh.summary: 法國規劃以國家計畫研發下一代戰機，目標2040年投入常規任務。
body: 法國將在法德FCAS合作計畫瓦解後，以國家計畫研發下一代戰鬥機。法國空天軍的目標是讓新機於2040年投入常規任務，並於2050年承擔核威懾任務。
法國空天軍參謀長General Jerome Bellanger於14 October舉行的國會聽證會說明規劃。報導指出，外國合作仍可能用於特定技術，但Bellanger表示，這類合作不會是開發該機的根本條件。
報導稱，Rafale F5將作為中間階段，預計約於2035年推出，並納入與ACF相關的技術，包括推進系統、感測器，以及用於壓制敵方防空系統的Stratus RS武器。

en.title: France plans national next-generation fighter, targeting conventional operations by 2040
en.summary: France plans a national next-generation fighter, targeting conventional operations by 2040.
body: France will develop its next-generation combat aircraft as a national programme following the collapse of the Franco-German FCAS partnership. The French Air and Space Force is targeting conventional operations by 2040 and a nuclear deterrence role by 2050.

French Air and Space Force Chief of Staff General Jerome Bellanger outlined the plans during a parliamentary hearing on 14 October. Foreign cooperation on selected technologies remains possible, but Bellanger indicated it would not be fundamental to developing the aircraft.

The report says the Rafale F5 will provide an intermediate step and is expected around 2035. It will incorporate technologies relevant to the ACF, including propulsion, sensors and the Stratus RS weapon intended to suppress enemy air defences.

zh.title: 俄羅斯噴射無人機基地接近完工 設有八處發射平臺
zh.summary: 俄羅斯新建噴射無人機基地接近完工，並設有八處發射平臺。
body: 報導指出，衛星影像顯示，俄羅斯一處供噴射動力無人機發射的新大型基地已幾近完工；報導並轉述路透社稱，基地在六週內建成。
報導稱，該基地位於俄羅斯羅斯托夫地區，似乎用於發射Geran-4及Geran-5無人機。基地西側設有八處帶發射軌的平臺，面積約0.9平方公里，距俄羅斯Millerovo空軍基地約3.5公里。
報導引述分析人士表示，該基地可能在數週內或更早全面投入運作。

en.title: Russia's New Jet-Drone Base Nears Completion With Eight Launch Platforms
en.summary: Russia's new jet-drone base is nearing completion, with eight launch platforms.
body: Satellite images cited in the report show Russia has almost completed a new large base for launching jet-powered drones against Ukraine. The report also relays Reuters' account that the base was built in six weeks.

The facility is in Russia's Rostov region and appears intended for launching Geran-4 and Geran-5 drones, the report says. It reports eight platforms with launch rails on the western edge. The base covers about 0.9 square kilometres and is about 3.5 kilometres from Russia's Millerovo air base.
Analysts cited in the report believe the base could be fully operational in a few weeks or even sooner.
